receipt_ownership.build-native.sh: Captures exact binary/source versions, repository URLs, .deb hashes, and matching source archives for direct apt_packages inputs; records installed-packages.tsv and installed-file-owners.tsv for the full image. These are inventory maps, not the incorporated-code closure.
receipt_ownership.package.py: Slice 2 owns final staging and closure-derived distro attribution. Run it in this pinned image and consume install/, deps/, sources/, the installed package/file-owner maps, and enabled deb-src indexes. Resolve every shipped ELF runtime provider and installed *-dev header/static contributor; for each resolved Ubuntu package capture the exact matching .deb and source archives, identities, hashes, and installed copyright notice. Missing or ambiguous ownership/source/notice is a hard failure. The direct apt_packages list alone is not a complete contributor inventory. Slice 1 recipes currently contain sources.json, Dockerfile, build-native.sh, and the reused Steam Audio patch only; archive_sources are hash-pinned upstream source archives retained under sources/dependencies with their notices; final staging must add package.py, host-policy.json, and any other production packaging inputs to its source-access artifact.

archive_sources.name: meson
archive_sources.purpose: Build tool only. The engine requires Meson >= 1.3 and Ubuntu 22.04 ships 0.61; this is the PyPI sdist of the release Ubuntu 24.04 used, run from source without pip.
